evidence.cites: Times of India, 31 Jan 2019 (gram panchayat) and 4 Jun 2019 (ZPTC, MPTC), as cited by the page

caveats: Only the three largest parties are listed, so the party figures do not add up to the total; the rest went to others, independents and unlisted parties.
Party names are as the source gives them (TRS was renamed BRS in 2022).
The same page also says 12,571 gram panchayats in its summary box; we use 12,751 from its text. One of them is a typing slip and we cannot tell which.
Gram panchayat polls are non-party; these are the parties the source says backed the winning sarpanch candidates.
